# Bonavia Health (康程跨境医疗)

> Bonavia Health is a non-clinical medical care coordination service based in China. It helps international patients — mainly from Central Asia, Russian-speaking countries and Africa, and also from Europe and English-speaking countries — find suitable hospitals and specialists in China, get itemized cost estimates before travel, and arrange visas, transfers, hotels and medical interpreters. Bonavia Health does not diagnose or treat patients; all medical care is provided by licensed hospitals.

Key facts:
- Legal name: 康程跨境医疗服务有限责任公司 (Bonavia Health)
- Partner network: 80 hospitals and 24 clinics in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen and other major cities; 20,000+ international patients served per year
- Languages: English, Russian, French, Chinese (medical interpreters accompany patients)
- Focus areas: cancer care and second opinions, cardiology, orthopaedics and joint replacement, health check-ups, rehabilitation and Chinese medicine, access to new drugs in Hainan's Boao Lecheng pilot zone
- Service promise: reply within 24 hours; itemized estimate before travel; fees agreed in writing
- President: Maxim Zhang
- Contact: info@bonaviahealth.org · +86 180 2403 6999 (WhatsApp) · WeChat/Instagram/Facebook: bonaviahealth
